rec.name: Cart Drawer Upsell Carousel + Free Gift Block
rec.status: Built — layout bug fixed, awaiting client feedback

what.text: An inline cross-sell area inside the cart drawer, placed between the cart items/progress bar and the order summary. It has two parts. (1) An upsell carousel headed "Passt perfekt dazu" ("Fits perfectly"), with the social-proof line "8 von 10 Kunden kaufen zusätzlich" (8 out of 10 customers also buy this), prev/next arrows, and a product row with image, title and an "ADD" button. (2) A "Free gift" row showing a gift product (gift vouchers, "Für dich gratis" / free for you) with its own "ADD" button.

why.text: Cross-sell offers shown at the moment of purchase intent lift AOV with little friction, because the shopper is already committed. The "8 out of 10 customers" line adds social proof and makes the add-on feel like a normal part of the purchase. The free gift adds a reciprocity/"getting something extra" incentive and works with the gift milestone on the progress bar. Placing both inline with the cart items, rather than floating over them, keeps the cart contents visible, so the shopper does not lose track of what is in the cart.

how.text: Render the upsell and free-gift blocks as normal blocks in the cart drawer's scrollable content area, directly below the line items and above the sticky or summary area. Do NOT use floating or fixed positioning. In the original build the floating blocks covered the cart items and blocked scrolling, especially on small screens. The fix was to integrate them into the drawer flow and cut the cart header height from 90px to 60px. Build the upsell as a small horizontal carousel with arrows (one product visible at a time). Each card has an image, title, and a one-click "Add" button that calls the Shopify cart AJAX API. Build the free gift as a separate row with a headline, image, "free" label and an Add button. Test on mobile for overlap and scroll behavior.

items: Social-proof subline text ("8 von 10 Kunden kaufen zusätzlich")
Product source for recommendations (manual picks or Shopify recommendations) — I
Free gift product and label ("Für dich gratis")

dependencies.text: Needs a cart drawer (not a cart page) with a scrollable content area. Needs a product source for upsells (manual selection or Shopify's Search & Discovery recommendations). Needs a gift product (a gift voucher product here) and some logic to make it free, such as a discount automation, an app, or a script. The source does not say which one was used. The gift ties into the progress bar milestone in the same drawer. The "8 of 10" claim may be static text; the ticket does not say whether it is dynamic.

items: Upsell add-to-cart rate from the cart drawer
Cart-to-checkout rate (to confirm the extra content does not hurt checkout progression)
Cart drawer scroll depth and bounce/close rate on mobile

images.caption: Final cart drawer: progress bar, "Passt perfekt dazu" upsell carousel with the social-proof line, Free gift row, then order summary, orange checkout CTA, payment icons and trust badges. The upsell and gift areas are outlined in red.
The upsell and free gift sit inline in the drawer flow between the progress bar and the summary, not floating. The checkout CTA and trust area below are outlined as a separate zone.
